properties.description: Top-level medallion orchestrator for a full (cold-start) initial load. Runs pl_bronze_initial_load -> pl_silver_initial_load -> pl_gold_initial_load in sequence. All child pipelines live in the bronze workspace alongside this one (silver-promotion and gold-promotion notebooks live in the silver workspace; only the pipelines move here).

activities.name: Bronze initial load
activities.description: Runs pl_bronze_initial_load (weather backfill today, additional bronze ingest siblings later). waitOnCompletion=true so silver doesn't start until bronze data is fully landed.

activities.name: Silver initial load
activities.description: Runs pl_silver_initial_load (also in bronze workspace), which fans out the three silver_curated_* notebooks living in the silver workspace.

activities.name: Gold initial load
activities.description: Runs pl_gold_initial_load (in bronze workspace), which refreshes the gold-workspace silver_curated shortcut SEP and then builds all star-schema dimensions and facts in the contoso_retail_gold Warehouse via DROP+CTAS sprocs.
